senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; רָהַט) [runner,] rafter or floor beam running from wall to wall.—Pl. רָהִיטִים, רָהִיטִין.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 16a">Ḥag. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אבני ביתו ורָהִיטֵי ביתו וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>וקורות</he>) the stones and the rafters of his house testify against him (ref. to <cite ref="Habakkuk 2:11">Hab. II, 11</cite>); <cite ref="Taanit 11a">Taan. 11ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 291:2">Yalk. Is. 291</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31:4">Lev. R. s. 31</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00279"><he>רַהַט</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 985:17">Yalk. Cant. 985</cite> <he>רָהִיטֵנוּ התינוקות</he> ‘our runners’ (<cite ref="Song of Songs 1:17">Cant. I, 17</cite>), that means the school children.]
